{{2025–26 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2025–26 Washington Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Washington]] in the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies, led by second-year head coach [[Danny Sprinkle]], played their home games at [[Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion]] in [[Seattle|Seattle, Washington]] as second-year members of the [[Big Ten Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|2024–25 season]] 13–18, 4–16 in [[2024–25 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in last place.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Washington Huskies 2024-25 Regular Season NCAAM Schedule |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/team/schedule/_/id/264/season/2025 |access-date=2025-10-15 |website=ESPN |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=2024-25 Men's Big Ten Conference Season Summary |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/conferences/big-ten/men/2025.html |access-date=2025-10-15 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}}</ref> They failed to qualify for the [[2025 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]].
